protocol.allocation: ownerAllocatedBytes is already the reset interval; never subtract before. Per-callback is a normalization, not total heap or resident memory.
protocol.timing: Raster rows measure worker CPU replay/submit, not physical presentation. Active submit intervals use pointer down/up windows. Overall intervals include idle tails.
protocol.baseline: HEAD production C# with the earlier Web IME selection fix; same Release AOT options and device/browser/GPU.

delayedFontControls.observation: Both baseline and final initially show missing-glyph boxes, then render Hangul after fallback downloads complete without code or string changes. This is existing on-demand font loading, not a persistent new cache regression.

limits: One baseline warm trial, two final warm trials (including the tracked-tool smoke) and two cold continuous trials per variant are bounded local comparisons, not statistical or physical-device acceptance.
The first final cold trial did not improve input queue p95; cold long tails remain. No stable 60fps claim.
Desktop Chrome uses WebGPU; Android auto falls back to WebGL2. Do not compare cross-backend performance.
Initial SwiftShader GPU-crash attempts, Chrome109 AOT startup failure and stale gesture-jar failure are excluded from baseline comparisons.
Physical phone/browser/keyboard, physical finger feel and display scanout remain unverified.
